notes: Full description: Deviation::target_lint (pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:78) is typed as &'static str, but Deviation::id is typed as String. The 'static lifetime on target_lint means that any deviation loaded from a config file, a database, or a serde-deserialized JSON payload cannot set target_lint without leaking memory (Box::leak) or using a 'static constant. This contradicts the deviations-from-config use case that DeviationStore is designed for. Lint::id() returns &'static str because the lint's ID is a compile-time constant embedded in the binary, but the deviation is an operator artifact that may be constructed at runtime. Fix: change target_lint from &'static str to String. The comparison in find_deviation (line 497) and active_for_lint (line 468) compares &str with &str, so changing to String and comparing as .as_str() is trivial. When serde is eventually added to Deviation, String is also the correct type for JSON deserialization.
title: RUSTY: Deviation::target_lint should be String not &'static str
